A spacious and beautifully designed 4-bedroom semi-detached home, Type F in Rockfield offers modern family living in a peaceful yet highly convenient location.

Extending to approximately 124 sqm, this home features generous living accommodation, high-quality finishes and excellent energy efficiency ideal for growing families or those seeking extra space.

Situated within the highly sought-after Rockfield development in Newtownmountkennedy, residents benefit from village charm alongside superb access to Dublin, Greystones, and the Wicklow countryside.
